method: The monthly series is the till's own rail counters (recorded in the same call that produces the organic count). The all-time split additionally counts certificate-era sales from before the till kept rails, and names what neither record placed as rail_not_recorded rather than guessing.

payments.method: The same purchases, grouped three ways: payment protocol, settlement network, and currency. Each group divides the organic purchase total; do not add the groups together. House purchases are excluded. These are purchase counts, not revenue or unique buyers. Network gaps remain unrecorded; endpoint observations and trade-counter deliveries are outside these settlement counts.

trade_counter.what_this_is: Not a rail. Sales through the trade counter (/trade) are paid to a marketplace, off-chain from our view, and billed on a statement; they land on no chain and are counted here beside the rails so the denominator is honest, never inside them.

what_this_is: Organic purchases by payment protocol, network and currency, plus the monthly network history, from the same books /stats serves. House purchases excluded.
